description: Local file sharing in your browser. Inspired by Apple's AirDrop

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of PairDrop 1.11.2, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from Runtipi's app store.

data_storage: None: it keeps no data of its own
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps no data of its own, so there is nothing for an uninstall to keep or delete.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Sends files straight between browsers on this computer's network; nothing is stored on the server.
Only devices that can reach this address see each other, and this install answers on this computer alone.
